note: Mostly long-term residents and local workers; a handful of gravel pull-through traveler sites by the laundry/bath house sell by the night. Off US 1 at Wrens. --Claude
summary: Read bosssrv.com: confirmed $49 nightly (weekly $239, monthly $425), full hookups 30/50 A, call/text booking. Added hookups, facilities (laundry, showers, Wi-Fi, propane), booking note. sites (80-ft pull-throughs, derived from note prose) left as stored: the operator site states no rig length. Long-stay five tests pass (nightly rate + phone on its own site, $49 <= $50, no minimum, not a home community; test 4 borderline, see flag). Note rewritten to say what the park mostly is.
flags: Phone: the operator's site gives (404) 285-3179 (call or text, managers Daniel and Jessica Gaston); the stored 706-547-0402 does not appear on it.

Long-stay character (five tests): RV Life reviewers in 2025-2026 say 'Mostly long term residents', 'mostly local workers but there are about 5 graveled and very level sites' for travelers, 'a small, mostly long-term RV Park'. RV Life lists 50 sites, so ~5 traveler sites is right at the 1-in-10 line of test 4; the operator posts no count. Kept (nightly rate and phone on its own site, $49, no minimum), but AWH may want to look.
sites.max_rig_ft 80 / pull_through: derived from the old note; the operator site does not state a length. Reviewers confirm pull-through traveler sites.
